summary: Bradford's Instagram record on small business and the economy is extensive and consistently pro-small-business, framed around cutting red tape, lowering taxes, and supporting main streets. Bradford repeatedly proposes property tax relief for small businesses and manufacturers, including a 25% small business sub-class reduction and industrial tax cuts in response to U.S. tariffs (DUIl3M_Dx5X, DHW7KI5yH9x, DF5xWk4SBYU, C3GD7yhgljQ). Bradford pushes to streamline permitting, citing CafeTO and patio rules, and proposes changing the patio objection threshold to 25% of notified neighbours (DMPy-G5Aj9a, DMgZzjFSD9Y). Bradford champions Toronto as a competitive destination for investment, tech, and manufacturing jobs (DKkTxkPBw1X, DF8fbeLy4kM, Cq_54rLNVku) and supports the music/arts economy through CafeTO, Amplified Music on Patios, and a city Music Strategy (CWHEJK1LojO, CcEF3Ozu5M3, CVQPG8erZNo). Bradford opposes rideshare caps and outdated bylaws restricting small businesses (C3p_JTpA7p_, DDj3LNtxmQ5).
